retention.followSystemHelp:
Follow system: the job cleanup follows the system-level log retention policy.
Current system policy: {currentPolicy}.
If the job defines an override, the job-level policy takes precedence.

help.cron:
Supports 5-part or 6-part Cron.
5-part expressions are parsed as minute hour day month week, and the runtime fills the seconds placeholder automatically.
6-part expressions can set seconds explicitly.
help.timeout:
Maximum runtime allowed for a single job instance.
When the limit is exceeded, the system attempts to interrupt the execution and marks the execution log as timed out.
Leave some headroom above the normal runtime to avoid false positives.
help.maxExecutions:
Limits the accumulated execution count that participates in execution counting.
Once the limit is reached, the job is disabled automatically and the stop reason is recorded.
Set to 0 to disable the limit; manual Run Now actions do not increase the count.
help.scope:
Primary Node Only: only the current primary node runs the job.
All Nodes: every online node runs the job once.
help.concurrency:
Singleton: if one instance is already running on the current node, new triggers are skipped.

taxInvoices.subtitle: Choose a saved invoice profile and paid bills, then enter the amount requested from each bill. The back office confirms the invoice type and reviews the request.
taxInvoices.noticeTitle: The back office confirms the invoice type
taxInvoices.noticeDescription: You do not choose an invoice type. A submitted request first enters review and immediately reserves the invoiceable amount from each selected bill.

profile.empty: No active invoice profile is available. Add or reactivate one under Invoice profiles first.

invoice.empty: No paid bill currently has an invoiceable balance.
invoice.differentCurrency: One request can combine bills in one currency only
invoice.selectionLimit: One request can include up to 20 bills
invoice.amountRequired: Enter an amount for this bill
invoice.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above zero with valid decimal places
invoice.amountTooLarge: The amount cannot exceed this bill's invoiceable balance

taxInvoices.submitHint: After submission, this profile snapshot and bill allocation are frozen. Later profile edits do not change this request.

messages.created: Invoice request submitted for back-office review.
messages.reused: The earlier successful submission of this same request was recovered.
messages.createFailed: Submission failed. Check the amounts, refresh, and try again.

history.title: Request history
history.description: Only your requests and customer-visible processing reasons appear here.

reason.buyer_or_tax_information_incorrect: The invoice profile or tax information needs correction
reason.amount_or_billing_invoice_adjustment_req: The requested amount or selected bills need adjustment
reason.duplicate_request: This request duplicates an existing request
reason.business_not_invoiceable: This business cannot currently be invoiced
reason.order_or_refund_changed: The order or refund situation changed
reason.other: The request could not continue. Contact the merchant for details

taxInvoices.loadFailed: Invoiceable information is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
